Further elective courses
Students must get 9 CFU/ECTS by choosing one or more courses offered by the University of Milan. The course of choice
has to award a final mark. 
 
Please check https://mhr.cdl.unimi.it/en/courses/9-credit-courses.
 
Moreover, students must get 3 CFU by choosing from internship, workshops, assessment of advanced computer skills,
assessment of advanced knowledge foreign languages, traineeship abroad. 
 
Please check https://mhr.cdl.unimi.it/en/courses/3-credit-activities.
 
 
Students who do not have an Italian qualification can choose to obtain 3 CFU in Additional language skills: Italian (for more
details see the section Language test / computer literacy test)
